project_models.name: Contango three-project temporary model
project_models.source: Temporary estimate - verification pending: Consolidated CTGO model combines Manh Choh at Contango's 30% interest (75,000 AuEq oz/year, USD 1,250/AuEq oz AISC proxy, 4.5 years, USD 29.7M after-tax NPV at 5% and USD 1,600/oz gold), Johnson Tract at 100% (102,258 AuEq oz/year, USD 860/AuEq oz, 7 years, USD 615.4M after-tax NPV, 1,053,000 indicated plus 108,000 inferred AuEq oz), and Lucky Shot at 100% (45,000 AuEq oz/year, USD 1,250/AuEq oz AISC proxy, 2.9 years, 105,620 indicated plus 25,110 inferred Au oz). The USD 645.1M partial NPV excludes Lucky Shot because no comparable study NPV is disclosed. The 1,291,730 AuEq oz partial resource total combines Johnson Tract and Lucky Shot only; it excludes Manh Choh because its disclosed 1M oz figure is a reserve, not a mineral resource. This model combines incompatible study dates and price decks and is not a company-reported consolidated value. Manh Choh's USD 1,250 is 2027 cash-cost guidance used as an AISC proxy. Lucky Shot production is the 40,000-50,000 oz target midpoint; its mine life is calculated from the 130,730 oz 2023 resource divided by that midpoint; its AISC proxy uses Manh Choh's 2027 cash-cost midpoint. Johnson Tract's AuEq production is modelled as gold payable volume solely to allow the existing gold-equivalent engine to calculate. Sources: https://contangoore.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/6470afdaf94d2ac9f93d93e0_SIMS-Contango-Manh-Choh-Project-S-K-1300-TRS-FINAL-20230524-1-compressed-1.pdf https://contangoore.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/6821f7b4e19f1e3d7995598c_Johnson-Tract-Project-SK1300-Technical-Report-Initial-Assesment-May2025.pdf https://contangoore.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Contango-Silver-Gold-September-2026.pdf https://www.contangoore.com/press-release/contango-ore-announces-2025-year-end-financials-and-provides-2026-and-2027-production-guidance
